TIER_0.definition: Unusually high-value or high-leverage opportunity with strong fit and credible award, transition, acquisition-channel, financing, or reusable program access.

TIER_1.definition: High-fit actionable opportunity with manageable evidence or partner gaps.

TIER_2.definition: Good fit requiring material maturation, teaming, or timing improvement.

TIER_3.definition: Strategic preparation target or future demand signal.

TIER_4.definition: Remote or speculative fit; monitor only.

compliance_policy.prime_rule: PRIME is prohibited when a mandatory eligibility, registration, cybersecurity, data-handling, clearance, export-control, or certification gate is BLOCKED_MISSING_EVIDENCE, REQUIRES_LEGAL_REVIEW, or UNKNOWN unless the solicitation expressly permits resolution after selection and the risk is documented.
compliance_policy.downgrade_rule: When a mandatory gate cannot be satisfied by Worldshepherd directly, route to PARTNER, PREPARE, or NO_BID rather than overstate compliance.
compliance_policy.data_rule: The public repository is PUBLIC_ONLY and is not an authorized FCI, CUI, classified, or export-controlled technical-data environment.
compliance_policy.certification_rule: Automated checks may produce evidence but may not certify compliance or make government representations.
